dedupe_keys.name: dutch distribution centres geodata logistics buildings 1980 2021 4tu researchdata

description: This geodataset maps 26,951 logistics buildings in the Netherlands built before November 2021, with their business estates and the East-Southeast freight-corridor outline. Merten Nefs compiled the resource with the collaborators named in the source. Logistics includes trade, import, export, wholesale, transport and warehousing. The inventory selects buildings above 500 square metres, adding 4,533 large retail buildings on industrial sites and 782 buildings with logistics co-activity. Manufacturing and recycling facilities are excluded unless a separate logistics company is registered. Native national-release metadata state time coverage of 1880-2021. The earlier corridor-only dataset remains a separate historical resource, and the source says the national dataset replaces it. Files include GeoPackage, shapefile, GeoJSON and CSV, with a PDF method. Access links and the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence are retained. LISA 2020 employment data determine building selection and the same function is assumed for 2021. Differences from LISA 2017 can be filtered using the Current attribute. A sample suggests approximately ten percent brownfield development and ninety percent greenfield development. The physical logistics locations and sizes can support the existing freight-flow and exposure uses; no simulation was reproduced. Geometry resolution, current file availability and classification accuracy were not independently checked.
